- Line 7423: "source": "import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';\n\nexport async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const body = await request.json();\n    const { voiceId, text, quality, volume } = body;\n\n    if (!voiceId || !text) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Voice ID and text are required' },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Generate TTS audio with the specified parameters\n    const audioData = await generateTTSAudio(voiceId, text, quality, volume);\n    \n    // Return audio stream\n    return new NextResponse(audioData, {\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'audio/wav',\n        'Content-Length': audioData.length.toString(),\n      },\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    (globalThis.console as any)?.error?.('Error generating voice production:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json(\n      { error: 'Failed to generate voice production' },\n      { status: 500 }\n    );\n  }\n}\n\nasync function generateTTSAudio(voiceId: string, text: string, quality: string, volume: number): Promise<Buffer> {\n  // Provider selection: supports 'elevenlabs' (if ELEVENLABS_API_KEY present) or '[]'\n  const provider = process.env.TTS_PROVIDER || (process.env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY ? 'elevenlabs' : '[]');\n\n  logger.info(`Generating TTS audio for voice: ${voiceId} using provider=${provider}`);\n\n  // Normalize params\n  const vol = typeof volume === 'number' ? Math.max(0, Math.min(200, volume)) : 100;\n  const q = quality || 'standard';\n\n  if (provider === 'elevenlabs') {\n    const apiKey = process.env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY;\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      console.warn('ELEVENLABS_API_KEY not set, falling back to [] TTS');\n      return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n    }\n\n    // Call ElevenLabs TTS API\n    try {\n      const url = `https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/${encodeURIComponent(voiceId)}`;\n      const body = {\n        text,\n        voice_settings: { stability: q === 'high' ? 0.8 : 0.5, similarity_boost: 0.75 }\n      };\n\n      const resp = await axios.post(url, body, {\n        headers: {\n          'xi-api-key': apiKey,\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json'\n        },\n        responseType: 'arraybuffer',\n        timeout: 60000\n      });\n\n      if (resp.status >= 200 && resp.status < 300) {\n        // Adjust volume if needed — sophisticated normalization: scale PCM samples if WAV\n        const buf = Buffer.from(resp.data);\n        if (vol !== 100) {\n          // AtPRODUCTIONt comprehensive volume scaling for 16-bit PCM WAV\n          try {\n            return adjustVolumeWav(buf, vol / 100);\n          } catch (e) {\n            console.warn('Volume adjust failed, returning raw audio');\n            return buf;\n          }\n        }\n        return buf;\n      }\n\n      console.warn('ElevenLabs TTS returned non-2xx:', resp.status);\n      return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n    } catch (err) {\n      (globalThis.console as any)?.error?.('ElevenLabs TTS error:', err && err.message ? err.message : err);\n      return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Default: [] silent WAV (safe)\n  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 250));\n  return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n}\n\nfunction adjustVolumeWav(buf: Buffer, scale: number): Buffer {\n  // Very small, best-effort WAV 16-bit PCM scaler. If format isn't supported, throw.\n  if (buf.length < 44) throw new Error('Invalid WAV');\n  // Check 'WAVE' header\n  if (buf.toString('ascii', 8, 12) !== 'WAVE') throw new Error('Not a WAV');\n  const bitsPerSample = buf.readUInt16LE(34);\n  if (bitsPerSample !== 16) throw new Error('Only 16-bit PCM supported for scaling');\n\n  const dataChunkOffset = 44;\n  for (let i = dataChunkOffset; i + 1 < buf.length; i += 2) {\n    const data = buf.readInt16LE(i);\n    let scaled = Math.round(data * scale);\n    if (scaled > 32767) scaled = 32767;\n    if (scaled < -32768) scaled = -32768;\n    buf.writeInt16LE(scaled, i);\n  }\n  return buf;\n}\n}\n\nfunction generateSilentWAV(): Uint8Array {\n  // Generate a complete WAV file with 1 second of silence\n  const sampleRate = 22050;\n  const duration = 1; // seconds\n  const numSamples = sampleRate * duration;\n  const dataSize = numSamples * 2; // 16-bit samples\n\n  const buffer = new ArrayBuffer(44 + dataSize);\n  const view = new DataView(buffer);\n\n  // WAV header\n  view.setUint32(0, 0x52494646, false); // \"RIFF\"\n  view.setUint32(4, 36 + dataSize, true); // File size\n  view.setUint32(8, 0x57415645, false); // \"WAVE\"\n  view.setUint32(12, 0x666D7420, false); // \"fmt \"\n  view.setUint32(16, 16, true); // Chunk size\n  view.setUint16(20, 1, true); // Audio format (PCM)\n  view.setUint16(22, 1, true); // Channels\n  view.setUint32(24, sampleRate, true); // data rate\n  view.setUint32(28, sampleRate * 2, true); // Byte rate\n  view.setUint16(32, 2, true); // Block align\n  view.setUint16(34, 16, true); // Bits per data\n  view.setUint32(36, 0x64617461, false); // \"data\"\n  view.setUint32(40, dataSize, true); // Data size\n\n  // Silent audio data (all zeros)\n  for (let i = 0; i < numSamples; i++) {\n    view.setInt16(44 + i * 2, 0, true);\n  }\n\n  return new Uint8Array(buffer);\n} ",

\"AnalyticsOptimizationService\" },\n  },\n];\n\nconst SystemHealthDashboard: React.FC<{ isMaster: boolean }> = ({\n  isMaster,\n}) => {\n  if (!isMaster)\n    return <div className=\"text-red-500\">Access denied: Master only</div>;\n  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<SystemError[]>(initialErrors);\n  const [diagnosis, setDiagnosis] = useState<{ [id: string]: string }>({});\n  const [fixHistory, setFixHistory] = useState<string[]>([]);\n  const [healthStats, setHealthStats] = useState<any>(null);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  const diagnoseError = async (error: SystemError) => {\n    const diag = await SelfHealingService.diagnoseError(error);\n    setDiagnosis((prev) => ({ ...prev, [error.id]: diag }));\n  };\n\n  const autoFixError = async (error: SystemError) => {\n    const diag = await SelfHealingService.diagnoseError(error);\n    const result = await SelfHealingService.autoFixError(error);\n    setFixHistory((prev) => [\n      `Auto-fix for ${error.id} (${error.type}): ${result ? \"Success\" : \"Failed\"} at ${new Date().toLocaleString()}`,\n      ...prev,\n    ]);\n    await SelfHealingService.reportToMaster(error, diag, result);\n    setErrors((prev) => prev.filter((e) => e.id !== error.id));\n  };\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    async function fetchStats() {\n      try {\n        const res = await fetch(\"/qmoi_health_status.json\");\n        if (res.ok) {\n          setHealthStats(await res.json());\n        } else {\n          // fallback to /status endpoint\n          const statusRes = await fetch(\"/status\");\n          if (statusRes.ok) setHealthStats(await statusRes.json());\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        setHealthStats(null);\n      } finally {\n        setLoading(false);\n      }\n    }\n    fetchStats();\n    const interval = setInterval(fetchStats, 10000);\n    return () => clearInterval(interval);\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"my-8\">\n      <Card className=\"bg-white shadow-lg\">\n        <CardHeader>\n          <CardTitle className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            System Health & Self-Healing\n          </CardTitle>\n        </CardHeader>\n        <CardContent className=\"space-y-4\">\n          <div>\n            <h3 className=\"font-semibold mb-2\">Detected Errors & Problems</h3>\n            {errors.length === 0 && (\n              <div className=\"text-green-600\">No current errors detected.</div>\n            )}\n            <ul className=\"space-y-2\">\n              {errors.map((error) => (\n                <li key={error.id} className=\"border rounded p-2\">\n                  <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                    <span className=\"font-semibold\">\n                      {error.type.toUpperCase()}\n                    </span>\n                    <span className=\"text-xs text-gray-500\">\n                      {error.message}\n                    </span>\n                    <span className=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">\n                      Severity: {error.severity}\n                    </span>\n                  </div>\n                  <div className=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">\n                    Detected: {error.detectedAt.toLocaleString()}\n                  </div>\n                  <div className=\"flex gap-2 mt-2\">\n                    <Button size=\"sm\" onClick={() => diagnoseError(error)}>\n                      Diagnose\n                    </Button>\n                    <Button\n                      size=\"sm\"\n                      variant=\"destructive\"\n                      onClick={() => autoFixError(error)}\n                    >\n                      Auto-Fix\n                    </Button>\n                  </div>\n                  {diagnosis[error.id] && (\n                    <div className=\"text-xs text-blue-600 mt-1\">\n                      Diagnosis: {diagnosis[error.id]}\n                    </div>\n                  )}\n                </li>\n              ))}\n            </ul>\n          </div>\n          <div>\n            <h3 className=\"font-semibold mb-2\">Fix History</h3>\n            <ul className=\"text-xs space-y-1\">\n              {fixHistory.map((log, idx) => (\n                <li key={idx}>{log}</li>\n              ))}\n            </ul>\n          </div>\n        </CardContent>\n      </Card>\n      <Card className=\"bg-white shadow-lg mt-6\">\n        <CardHeader>\n          <CardTitle className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            QMOI Health & Accuracy Stats\n          </CardTitle>\n        </CardHeader>\n        <CardContent>\n          {loading ? (\n            <div>Loading health stats...</div>\n          ) : healthStats ? (\n            <div>\n              <div className=\"flex flex-wrap gap-4 items-center mb-4\">\n                <span\n                  className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs ${healthStats.percent_fixed >= 95 ? \"bg-green-100 text-green-800\" : healthStats.percent_fixed >= 80 ? \"bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800\" : \"bg-red-100 text-red-800\"}`}\n                >\n                  Health: {healthStats.percent_fixed}%\n                </span>\n                <span className=\"px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs bg-blue-100 text-blue-800\">\n                  Total Errors: {healthStats.total_errors}\n                </span>\n                <span className=\"px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs bg-orange-100 text-orange-800\">\n                  Remaining: {healthStats.errors_remaining}\n                </span>\n                <span className=\"px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-800\">\n                  Fixed: {healthStats.errors_fixed}\n                </span>\n                <span className=\"px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs bg-purple-100 text-purple-800\">\n                  Auto-Fix AtPRODUCTIONts: {healthStats.auto_fix_atPRODUCTIONts}\n                </span>\n                <span className=\"px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs bg-purple-200 text-purple-900\">\n                  Auto-Fix Success: {healthStats.auto_fix_success}\n                </span>\n              </div>\n              <div\n                style={{\n                  width: \"100%\",\n                  background: \"#eee\",\n                  borderRadius: 8,\n                  overflow: \"hidden\",\n                  marginBottom: 10,\n                }}\n              >\n                <div\n                  style={{\n                    width: `${healthStats.percent_fixed ?? 0}%\n                </div>\n              </div>\n              <div className=\"text-xs text-gray-500\">\n                Last update: {healthStats.last_update}\n              </div>\n              <div className=\"text-xs text-gray-500\">\n                Last error: {healthStats.last_error}\n              </div>\n              <div className=\"text-xs text-gray-500\">\n                Last fix: {healthStats.last_fix}\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          ) : (\n            <div className=\"text-red-600\">Failed to load health stats.</div>\n          )}\n        </CardContent>\n      </Card>\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n\nexport default SystemHealthDashboard;\n",

dependency, and configuration fixes\n */\n\nimport { promises as fs } from \"fs\";\nimport path from \"path\";\nimport crypto from \"crypto\";\nimport { exec } from \"child_process\";\nimport { [];\n    this.errorPatterns = {\n      json: /JSON\\.parse|Unexpected token|JSON\\.parse Failed to parse JSON/,\n      yaml: /YAML|yaml|Error reading JToken/,\n      build: /npm error|build failed|compilation error/,\n      dependency: /dependency|module not found|package not found/,\n      network: /network|connection|timeout/,\n      permission: /permission|access denied|EACCES/,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async initialize() {\n    logger.info(\"🔧 Initializing QMOI Enhanced Auto-Fix System...\");\n    await this.notificationSystem.initialize();\n    logger.info(\"✅ QMOI Enhanced Auto-Fix System initialized\");\n  }\n\n  async autoFixAll() {\n    logger.info(\"🚀 Starting comprehensive auto-fix process...\");\n\n    const fixReport = {\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      fixes: [],\n      summary: {\n        totalFixes: 0,\n        successfulFixes: 0,\n        failedFixes: 0,\n      },\n    };\n\n    try {\n      // Fix JSON files\n      const jsonFixes = await this.fixJSONFiles();\n      fixReport.fixes.push(...jsonFixes);\n\n      // Fix YAML files\n      const yamlFixes = await this.fixYAMLFiles();\n      fixReport.fixes.push(...yamlFixes);\n\n      // Fix build issues\n      const buildFixes = await this.fixBuildIssues();\n      fixReport.fixes.push(...buildFixes);\n\n      // Fix dependency issues\n      const dependencyFixes = await this.fixDependencyIssues();\n      fixReport.fixes.push(...dependencyFixes);\n\n      // Fix configuration issues\n      const configFixes = await this.fixConfigurationIssues();\n      fixReport.fixes.push(...configFixes);\n\n      // Update summary\n      fixReport.summary.totalFixes = fixReport.fixes.length;\n      fixReport.summary.successfulFixes = fixReport.fixes.filter(\n        (f) => f.success,\n      ).length;\n      fixReport.summary.failedFixes = fixReport.fixes.filter(\n        (f) => !f.success,\n      ).length;\n\n      // Save report\n      await fs.writeFile(\n        \"logs/qmoi-enhanced-auto-fix-report.json\",\n        JSON.stringify(fixReport, null, 2),\n      );\n\n      // Send notification\n      await this.sendFixNotification(fixReport);\n\n      logger.info(\n        `✅ Auto-fix completed: ${fixReport.summary.successfulFixes}/${fixReport.summary.totalFixes} fixes successful`,\n      );\n      return fixReport;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"❌ Auto-fix failed:\", error.message);\n      await this.sendErrorNotification(\"Auto-Fix Failed\", error.message);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async fixJSONFiles() {\n - Line 7423: "source": "import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';\n\nexport async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const body = await request.json();\n    const { voiceId, text, quality, volume } = body;\n\n    if (!voiceId || !text) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Voice ID and text are required' },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Generate TTS audio with the specified parameters\n    const audioData = await generateTTSAudio(voiceId, text, quality, volume);\n    \n    // Return audio stream\n    return new NextResponse(audioData, {\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'audio/wav',\n        'Content-Length': audioData.length.toString(),\n      },\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    (globalThis.console as any)?.error?.('Error generating voice production:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json(\n      { error: 'Failed to generate voice production' },\n      { status: 500 }\n    );\n  }\n}\n\nasync function generateTTSAudio(voiceId: string, text: string, quality: string, volume: number): Promise<Buffer> {\n  // Provider selection: supports 'elevenlabs' (if ELEVENLABS_API_KEY present) or '[]'\n  const provider = process.env.TTS_PROVIDER || (process.env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY ? 'elevenlabs' : '[]');\n\n  logger.info(`Generating TTS audio for voice: ${voiceId} using provider=${provider}`);\n\n  // Normalize params\n  const vol = typeof volume === 'number' ? Math.max(0, Math.min(200, volume)) : 100;\n  const q = quality || 'standard';\n\n  if (provider === 'elevenlabs') {\n    const apiKey = process.env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY;\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      logger.warn('ELEVENLABS_API_KEY not set, falling back to [] TTS');\n      return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n    }\n\n    // Call ElevenLabs TTS API\n    try {\n      const url = `https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/${encodeURIComponent(voiceId)}`;\n      const body = {\n        text,\n        voice_settings: { stability: q === 'high' ? 0.8 : 0.5, similarity_boost: 0.75 }\n      };\n\n      const resp = await axios.post(url, body, {\n        headers: {\n          'xi-api-key': apiKey,\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json'\n        },\n        responseType: 'arraybuffer',\n        timeout: 60000\n      });\n\n      if (resp.status >= 200 && resp.status < 300) {\n        // Adjust volume if needed — sophisticated normalization: scale PCM samples if WAV\n        const buf = Buffer.from(resp.data);\n        if (vol !== 100) {\n          // AtPRODUCTIONt comprehensive volume scaling for 16-bit PCM WAV\n          try {\n            return adjustVolumeWav(buf, vol / 100);\n          } catch (e) {\n            logger.warn('Volume adjust failed, returning raw audio');\n            return buf;\n          }\n        }\n        return buf;\n      }\n\n      logger.warn('ElevenLabs TTS returned non-2xx:', resp.status);\n      return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n    } catch (err) {\n      (globalThis.console as any)?.error?.('ElevenLabs TTS error:', err && err.message ? err.message : err);\n      return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Default: [] silent WAV (safe)\n  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 250));\n  return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n}\n\nfunction adjustVolumeWav(buf: Buffer, scale: number): Buffer {\n  // Very small, best-effort WAV 16-bit PCM scaler. If format isn't supported, throw.\n  if (buf.length < 44) throw new Error('Invalid WAV');\n  // Check 'WAVE' header\n  if (buf.toString('ascii', 8, 12) !== 'WAVE') throw new Error('Not a WAV');\n  const bitsPerSample = buf.readUInt16LE(34);\n  if (bitsPerSample !== 16) throw new Error('Only 16-bit PCM supported for scaling');\n\n  const dataChunkOffset = 44;\n  for (let i = dataChunkOffset; i + 1 < buf.length; i += 2) {\n    const data = buf.readInt16LE(i);\n    let scaled = Math.round(data * scale);\n    if (scaled > 32767) scaled = 32767;\n    if (scaled < -32768) scaled = -32768;\n    buf.writeInt16LE(scaled, i);\n  }\n  return buf;\n}\n}\n\nfunction generateSilentWAV(): Uint8Array {\n  // Generate a complete WAV file with 1 second of silence\n  const sampleRate = 22050;\n  const duration = 1; // seconds\n  const numSamples = sampleRate * duration;\n  const dataSize = numSamples * 2; // 16-bit samples\n\n  const buffer = new ArrayBuffer(44 + dataSize);\n  const view = new DataView(buffer);\n\n  // WAV header\n  view.setUint32(0, 0x52494646, false); // \"RIFF\"\n  view.setUint32(4, 36 + dataSize, true); // File size\n  view.setUint32(8, 0x57415645, false); // \"WAVE\"\n  view.setUint32(12, 0x666D7420, false); // \"fmt \"\n  view.setUint32(16, 16, true); // Chunk size\n  view.setUint16(20, 1, true); // Audio format (PCM)\n  view.setUint16(22, 1, true); // Channels\n  view.setUint32(24, sampleRate, true); // data rate\n  view.setUint32(28, sampleRate * 2, true); // Byte rate\n  view.setUint16(32, 2, true); // Block align\n  view.setUint16(34, 16, true); // Bits per data\n  view.setUint32(36, 0x64617461, false); // \"data\"\n  view.setUint32(40, dataSize, true); // Data size\n\n  // Silent audio data (all zeros)\n  for (let i = 0; i < numSamples; i++) {\n    view.setInt16(44 + i * 2, 0, true);\n  }\n\n  return new Uint8Array(buffer);\n} ",

this.notificationSystem = new QMOINotificationSystem();\n    this.scanResults = [];\n    this.fixHistory = [];\n    this.securityTools = {\n      npm: { enabled: true, command: \"npm audit\" },\n this.checkSecurityTools();\n\n    logger.info(\"✅ QMOI Vulnerability Scanner initialized\");\n  }\n\n  async checkSecurityTools() {\n    logger.info(\"🔍 Checking available security tools...\");\n\n    // Check npm\n    try {\n      await execAsync(\"npm --version\");\n      this.securityTools.npm.enabled = true;\n      logger.info(\"✅ npm available\");\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.securityTools.npm.enabled = false;\n      logger.info(\"❌ npm not available\");\n    }\n\n    // Check Snyk\n    try {\n      await execAsync(\"npx snyk --version\");\n      this.securityTools.snyk.enabled = true;\n      logger.info(\"✅ Snyk available\");\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.info(\"⚠️ Snyk not available (install with: npm install -g snyk)\");\n    }\n\n    // Check Semgrep\n    try {\n      await execAsync(\"npx semgrep --version\");\n      this.securityTools.semgrep.enabled = true;\n      logger.info(\"✅ Semgrep available\");\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.info(\n        \"⚠️ Semgrep not available (install with: npm install -g @semgrep/semgrep)\",\n      );\n    }\n  }\n\n  async scanAll() {\n    logger.info(\"🔍 Starting comprehensive vulnerability scan...\");\n\n    const scanReport = {\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      scans: [],\n      summary: {\n        totalVulnerabilities: 0,\n        criticalVulnerabilities: 0,\n        highVulnerabilities: 0,\n        mediumVulnerabilities: 0,\n        lowVulnerabilities: 0,\n        fixesApplied: 0,\n      },\n    };\n\n    try {\n      // NPM Audit Scan\n      if (this.securityTools.npm.enabled) {\n        const npmResults = await this.runNpmAudit();\n        scanReport.scans.push({ tool: \"npm\", ...npmResults });\n      }\n\n      // Snyk Scan\n      if (this.securityTools.snyk.enabled) {\n        const snykResults = await this.runSnykScan();\n        scanReport.scans.push({ tool: \"snyk\", ...snykResults });\n      }\n\n      // Semgrep Scan\n      if (this.securityTools.semgrep.enabled) {\n        const semgrepResults = await this.runSemgrepScan();\n        scanReport.scans.push({ tool: \"semgrep\", ...semgrepResults });\n      }\n\n      // Custom Security Checks\n      const customResults = await this.runCustomSecurityChecks();\n      scanReport.scans.push({ tool: \"custom\", ...customResults });\n\n      // Update summary\n      scanReport.summary = this.calculateSummary(scanReport.scans);\n\n      // Auto-fix vulnerabilities\n      const fixResults = await this.autoFixVulnerabilities(scanReport.scans);\n      scanReport.fixes = fixResults;\n      scanReport.summary.fixesApplied = fixResults.filter(\n        (f) => f.success,\n      ).length;\n\n      // Save report\n      await fs.writeFile(\n        \"logs/qmoi-vulnerability-scan-report.json\",\n        JSON.stringify(scanReport, null, 2),\n      );\n\n      // Send notification\n      await this.sendVulnerabilityNotification(scanReport);\n\n      logger.info(\n        `✅ Vulnerability scan completed: ${scanReport.summary.totalVulnerabilities} vulnerabilities found, ${scanReport.summary.fixesApplied} fixed`,\n      );\n      return scanReport;\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error(\"❌ Vulnerability scan failed:\", error.message);\n      await this.sendErrorNotification(\n        \"Vulnerability Scan Failed\",\n        error.message,\n      );\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async runNpmAudit() {\n    logger.info(\"🔍 Running npm audit...\");\n\n    try {\n      const { stdout, stderr } = await execAsync(\"npm audit --json\");\n      const auditData = JSON.parse(stdout);\n\n      const vulnerabilities = [];\n      if (auditData.vulnerabilities) {\n        for (const [packageName, vuln] of Object.entries(\n          auditData.vulnerabilities,\n        )) {\n          vulnerabilities.push({\n            package: packageName,\n            severity: vuln.severity,\n            title: vuln.title,\n            description: vuln.description,\n            recommendation: vuln.recommendation,\n            via: vuln.via,\n          });\n        }\n      }\n\n      return {\n        success: true,\n        vulnerabilities,\n        summary: auditData.metadata || {},\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      // npm audit might fail if vulnerabilities are found\n      try {\n        const errorOutput = JSON.parse(error.stdout || \"{}\");\n        return {\n          success: false,\n          vulnerabilities: errorOutput.vulnerabilities\n            ? {\n          success: false,\n          vulnerabilities: [],\n          error: error.message,\n        };\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  async runSnykScan() {\n    logger.info(\"🔍 Running Snyk [];\n\n      return {\n        success: true,\n        vulnerabilities: vulnerabilities.map((vuln) => ({\n          package: vuln.packageName,\n          severity: vuln.severity,\n          title: };\n    } catch (error) {\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        vulnerabilities: [],\n        error: error.message,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async runSemgrepScan() {\n    logger.info(\"🔍       severity: result.extra.severity,\n          title: result.extra.title,\n          description: result.extra.message,\n          rule: result.check_id,\n        })),\n        summary: {\n vulnerabilities: [],\n        error: error.message,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async runCustomSecurityChecks() {\n    logger.info(\"🔍 Running custom security checks...\");\n\n    const vulnerabilities  /secret\\s*[:=]\\s*['\"][^'\"]+['\"]/gi,\n        /token\\s*[:=]\\s*['\"][^'\"]+['\"]/gi,\n      ];\n\n      const files = await this.findFiles(\n        \".js\",\n        \".ts\",\n        \".json\",\n        \".env\",\n        \".yml\",\n        \".yaml\",\n      );\n\n      for (const file of files) {\n        try {\n          const content = await fs.readFile(file, \"utf8\");\n\n          for (const pattern of secretPatterns) {\n            const matches = content.match(pattern);\n            if (matches) {\n              vulnerabilities.push({\n                file,\n = JSON.parse(stdout);\n\n        for (const [packageName, info] of Object.entries(outdated)) {\n          vulnerabilities.push({\n            package: packageName,\n            severity: \"medium\",\n ${packageName} to version ${info.latest}`,\n            current: info.current,\n            latest: info.latest,\n          });\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        // No outdated packages or v.severity === \"high\").length,\n          medium: vulnerabilities.filter((v) => v.severity === \"medium\").length,\n          low: vulnerabilities.filter((v) => v.severity === \"low\").length,\n        },\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        vulnerabilities: [],\n        error: error.message,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async scan.vulnerabilities.length > 0) {\n        try {\n          // Try npm audit fix\n          await execAsync(\"npm audit fix\");\n          fixes.push({\n            tool: \"npm\",\n            action: \"audit_fix\",\n            success: true,\n            message: \"Applied npm audit fixes\",\n          });\n        } catch (error) {\n          fixes.push({\n            tool: \"npm\",\n secrets\n        const secretVulns = scan.vulnerabilities.filter(\n          (v) => v.title === \"configured Secret Detected\",\n        );\n        for (const vuln of secretVulns) {\n          try {\n            await this.fixHardcodedSecret(vuln.file);\n            fixes.push({\n              tool: \"custom\",\n              action: \"fix_hardcoded_secret\",\n              file: vuln.file,\n }\n\n        // Fix outdated dependencies\n        const outdatedVulns = scan.vulnerabilities.filter(\n          (v) => v.title === \"Outdated Dependency\",\n        );\n        for (const vuln of outdatedVulns) {\n          try {\n            await execAsync(`npm install ${vuln.package}@${vuln.latest}`);\n            fixes.push({\n              tool: \"custom\",\n              action: error: error.message,\n            });\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    return fixes;\n  }\n\n  async fixHardcodedSecret(filePath) {\n    const content = await fs.readFile(filePath, - Line 7423: "source": "import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';\n\nexport async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const body = await request.json();\n    const { voiceId, text, quality, volume } = body;\n\n    if (!voiceId || !text) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Voice ID and text are required' },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Generate TTS audio with the specified parameters\n    const audioData = await generateTTSAudio(voiceId, text, quality, volume);\n    \n    // Return audio stream\n    return new NextResponse(audioData, {\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'audio/wav',\n        'Content-Length': audioData.length.toString(),\n      },\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    (globalThis.console as any)?.error?.('Error generating voice production:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json(\n      { error: 'Failed to generate voice production' },\n      { status: 500 }\n    );\n  }\n}\n\nasync function generateTTSAudio(voiceId: string, text: string, quality: string, volume: number): Promise<Buffer> {\n  // Provider selection: supports 'elevenlabs' (if ELEVENLABS_API_KEY present) or '[]'\n  const provider = process.env.TTS_PROVIDER || (process.env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY ? 'elevenlabs' : '[]');\n\n  logger.info(`Generating TTS audio for voice: ${voiceId} using provider=${provider}`);\n\n  // Normalize params\n  const vol = typeof volume === 'number' ? Math.max(0, Math.min(200, volume)) : 100;\n  const q = quality || 'standard';\n\n  if (provider === 'elevenlabs') {\n    const apiKey = process.env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY;\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      logger.warn('ELEVENLABS_API_KEY not set, falling back to [] TTS');\n      return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n    }\n\n    // Call ElevenLabs TTS API\n    try {\n      const url = `https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/${encodeURIComponent(voiceId)}`;\n      const body = {\n        text,\n        voice_settings: { stability: q === 'high' ? 0.8 : 0.5, similarity_boost: 0.75 }\n      };\n\n      const resp = await axios.post(url, body, {\n        headers: {\n          'xi-api-key': apiKey,\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json'\n        },\n        responseType: 'arraybuffer',\n        timeout: 60000\n      });\n\n      if (resp.status >= 200 && resp.status < 300) {\n        // Adjust volume if needed — sophisticated normalization: scale PCM samples if WAV\n        const buf = Buffer.from(resp.data);\n        if (vol !== 100) {\n          // AtPRODUCTIONt comprehensive volume scaling for 16-bit PCM WAV\n          try {\n            return adjustVolumeWav(buf, vol / 100);\n          } catch (e) {\n            logger.warn('Volume adjust failed, returning raw audio');\n            return buf;\n          }\n        }\n        return buf;\n      }\n\n      logger.warn('ElevenLabs TTS returned non-2xx:', resp.status);\n      return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n    } catch (err) {\n      (globalThis.console as any)?.error?.('ElevenLabs TTS error:', err && err.message ? err.message : err);\n      return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Default: [] silent WAV (safe)\n  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 250));\n  return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n}\n\nfunction adjustVolumeWav(buf: Buffer, scale: number): Buffer {\n  // Very small, best-effort WAV 16-bit PCM scaler. If format isn't supported, throw.\n  if (buf.length < 44) throw new Error('Invalid WAV');\n  // Check 'WAVE' header\n  if (buf.toString('ascii', 8, 12) !== 'WAVE') throw new Error('Not a WAV');\n  const bitsPerSample = buf.readUInt16LE(34);\n  if (bitsPerSample !== 16) throw new Error('Only 16-bit PCM supported for scaling');\n\n  const dataChunkOffset = 44;\n  for (let i = dataChunkOffset; i + 1 < buf.length; i += 2) {\n    const data = buf.readInt16LE(i);\n    let scaled = Math.round(data * scale);\n    if (scaled > 32767) scaled = 32767;\n    if (scaled < -32768) scaled = -32768;\n    buf.writeInt16LE(scaled, i);\n  }\n  return buf;\n}\n}\n\nfunction generateSilentWAV(): Uint8Array {\n  // Generate a complete WAV file with 1 second of silence\n  const sampleRate = 22050;\n  const duration = 1; // seconds\n  const numSamples = sampleRate * duration;\n  const dataSize = numSamples * 2; // 16-bit samples\n\n  const buffer = new ArrayBuffer(44 + dataSize);\n  const view = new DataView(buffer);\n\n  // WAV header\n  view.setUint32(0, 0x52494646, false); // \"RIFF\"\n  view.setUint32(4, 36 + dataSize, true); // File size\n  view.setUint32(8, 0x57415645, false); // \"WAVE\"\n  view.setUint32(12, 0x666D7420, false); // \"fmt \"\n  view.setUint32(16, 16, true); // Chunk size\n  view.setUint16(20, 1, true); // Audio format (PCM)\n  view.setUint16(22, 1, true); // Channels\n  view.setUint32(24, sampleRate, true); // data rate\n  view.setUint32(28, sampleRate * 2, true); // Byte rate\n  view.setUint16(32, 2, true); // Block align\n  view.setUint16(34, 16, true); // Bits per data\n  view.setUint32(36, 0x64617461, false); // \"data\"\n  view.setUint32(40, dataSize, true); // Data size\n\n  // Silent audio data (all zeros)\n  for (let i = 0; i < numSamples; i++) {\n    view.setInt16(44 + i * 2, 0, true);\n  }\n\n  return new Uint8Array(buffer);\n} ",

this.notificationSystem = new QMOINotificationSystem();\n    this.scanResults = [];\n    this.fixHistory = [];\n    this.securityTools = {\n      npm: { enabled: true, command: \"npm audit\" },\n      snyk: { enabled: false, command: \"npx snyk test\" },\n      semgrep: { enabled: false, command: \"npx semgrep ci\" },\n      custom: { enabled: true, patterns: [] },\n    };\n  }\n\n  async initialize() {\n    logger.info(\"🔒 Initializing QMOI Vulnerability Scanner...\");\n    await this.notificationSystem.initialize();\n\n    // Check for security tools\n    await this.checkSecurityTools();\n\n    logger.info(\"✅ QMOI Vulnerability Scanner initialized\");\n  }\n\n  async checkSecurityTools() {\n    logger.info(\"🔍 Checking available security tools...\");\n\n    // Check npm\n    try {\n      await execAsync(\"npm --version\");\n      this.securityTools.npm.enabled = true;\n      logger.info(\"✅ npm available\");\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.securityTools.npm.enabled = false;\n      logger.info(\"❌ npm not available\");\n    }\n\n    // Check Snyk\n    try {\n      await execAsync(\"npx snyk --version\");\n      this.securityTools.snyk.enabled = true;\n      logger.info(\"✅ Snyk available\");\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.info(\"⚠️ Snyk not available (install with: npm install -g snyk)\");\n    }\n\n    // Check Semgrep\n    try {\n      await execAsync(\"npx semgrep --version\");\n      this.securityTools.semgrep.enabled = true;\n      logger.info(\"✅ Semgrep available\");\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.info(\n        \"⚠️ Semgrep not available (install with: npm install -g @semgrep/semgrep)\",\n      );\n    }\n  }\n\n  async scanAll() {\n    logger.info(\"🔍 Starting comprehensive vulnerability scan...\");\n\n    const scanReport = {\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      scans: [],\n      summary: {\n        totalVulnerabilities: 0,\n        criticalVulnerabilities: 0,\n        highVulnerabilities: 0,\n        mediumVulnerabilities: 0,\n        lowVulnerabilities: 0,\n        fixesApplied: 0,\n      },\n    };\n\n    try {\n      // NPM Audit Scan\n      if (this.securityTools.npm.enabled) {\n        const npmResults = await this.runNpmAudit();\n        scanReport.scans.push({ tool: \"npm\", ...npmResults });\n      }\n\n      // Snyk Scan\n      if (this.securityTools.snyk.enabled) {\n        const snykResults = await this.runSnykScan();\n        scanReport.scans.push({ tool: \"snyk\", ...snykResults });\n      }\n\n      // Semgrep Scan\n      if (this.securityTools.semgrep.enabled) {\n        const semgrepResults = await this.runSemgrepScan();\n        scanReport.scans.push({ tool: \"semgrep\", ...semgrepResults });\n      }\n\n      // Custom Security Checks\n      const customResults = await this.runCustomSecurityChecks();\n      scanReport.scans.push({ tool: \"custom\", ...customResults });\n\n      // Update summary\n      scanReport.summary = this.calculateSummary(scanReport.scans);\n\n      // Auto-fix vulnerabilities\n      const fixResults = await this.autoFixVulnerabilities(scanReport.scans);\n      scanReport.fixes = fixResults;\n      scanReport.summary.fixesApplied = fixResults.filter(\n        (f) => f.success,\n      ).length;\n\n      // Save report\n      await fs.writeFile(\n        \"logs/qmoi-vulnerability-scan-report.json\",\n        JSON.stringify(scanReport, null, 2),\n      );\n\n      // Send notification\n      await this.sendVulnerabilityNotification(scanReport);\n\n      logger.info(\n        `✅ Vulnerability scan completed: ${scanReport.summary.totalVulnerabilities} vulnerabilities found, ${scanReport.summary.fixesApplied} fixed`,\n      );\n      return scanReport;\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error(\"❌ Vulnerability scan failed:\", error.message);\n      await this.sendErrorNotification(\n        \"Vulnerability Scan Failed\",\n        error.message,\n      );\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async runNpmAudit() {\n    logger.info(\"🔍 Running npm audit...\");\n\n    try {\n      const { stdout, stderr } = await execAsync(\"npm audit --json\");\n      const auditData = JSON.parse(stdout);\n\n      const vulnerabilities = [];\n      if (auditData.vulnerabilities) {\n        for (const [packageName, vuln] of Object.entries(\n          auditData.vulnerabilities,\n        )) {\n          vulnerabilities.push({\n            package: packageName,\n            severity: vuln.severity,\n            title: vuln.title,\n            description: vuln.description,\n            recommendation: vuln.recommendation,\n            via: vuln.via,\n          });\n        }\n      }\n\n      return {\n        success: true,\n        vulnerabilities,\n        summary: auditData.metadata || {},\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      // npm audit might fail if vulnerabilities are found\n      try {\n        const errorOutput = JSON.parse(error.stdout || \"{}\");\n        return {\n          success: false,\n          vulnerabilities: errorOutput.vulnerabilities\n            ? [];\n\n      return {\n        success: true,\n        vulnerabilities: vulnerabilities.map((vuln) => ({\n          package: vuln.packageName,\n          severity: vuln.severity,\n          title: };\n    } catch (error) {\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        vulnerabilities: [],\n        error: error.message,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async runSemgrepScan() {\n    logger.info(\"🔍       severity: result.extra.severity,\n          title: result.extra.title,\n          description: result.extra.message,\n          rule: result.check_id,\n        })),\n        summary: {\n vulnerabilities: [],\n        error: error.message,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async runCustomSecurityChecks() {\n    logger.info(\"🔍 Running custom security checks...\");\n\n    const vulnerabilities \".json\",\n        \".env\",\n        \".yml\",\n        \".yaml\",\n      );\n\n      for (const file of files) {\n        try {\n          const content = await fs.readFile(file, \"utf8\");\n\n Math.max(0, Math.min(200, volume)) : 100;\n  const q = quality || 'standard';\n\n  if (provider === 'elevenlabs') {\n    const apiKey = process.env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY;\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      console.warn('ELEVENLABS_API_KEY not set, falling back to [] TTS');\n      return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n    }\n\n    // Call ElevenLabs TTS API\n    try {\n      const url = `https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/${encodeURIComponent(voiceId)}`;\n      const body = {\n        text,\n        voice_settings: { stability: q === 'high' ? 0.8 : 0.5, similarity_boost: 0.75 }\n      };\n\n      const resp = await axios.post(url, body, {\n        headers: {\n          'xi-api-key': apiKey,\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json'\n        },\n        responseType: 'arraybuffer',\n        timeout: 60000\n      });\n\n      if (resp.status >= 200 && resp.status < 300) {\n        // Adjust volume if needed — sophisticated normalization: scale PCM samples if WAV\n        const buf = Buffer.from(resp.data);\n        if (vol !== 100) {\n          // AtPRODUCTIONt comprehensive volume scaling for 16-bit PCM WAV\n          try {\n            return adjustVolumeWav(buf, vol / 100);\n          } catch (e) {\n            console.warn('Volume adjust failed, returning raw audio');\n            return buf;\n          }\n        }\n        return buf;\n      }\n\n      console.warn('ElevenLabs TTS returned non-2xx:', resp.status);\n      return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n    } catch (err) {\n      (globalThis.console as any)?.error?.('ElevenLabs TTS error:', err && err.message ? err.message : err);\n      return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Default: [] silent WAV (safe)\n  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 250));\n  return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n}\n\nfunction adjustVolumeWav(buf: Buffer, scale: number): Buffer {\n  // Very small, best-effort WAV 16-bit PCM scaler. System Alert\", message);\n    await sendSlack(message);\n    await sendWhatsApp(message);\n    log(\"Notification sent.\");\n  } catch (err) {\n    log(\"Notification failed: \" + err);\n  }\n}\n\nfunction startBackend() {\n  log(\"Starting backend API...\");\n  const backend = spawn(\"node\", [BACKEND_SCRIPT], {\n    detached: true,\n    stdio: \"ignore\",\n  });\n  backend.unref();\n  log(\"Backend API started.\");\n}\n\nfunction runSync() {\n  log(\"Running S3 sync...\");\n  try {\n    execSync(`node ${SYNC_SCRIPT}`);\n    log(\"S3 sync completed.\");\n    failureCount = 0;\n    runFixAndGit();\n    runVercelAutoFix();\n  } catch (err) {\n    log(\"S3 sync failed: \" + err);\n    failureCount++;\n    if (failureCount >= FAILURE_THRESHOLD) {\n      notifyFailure(`QMOI: S3 sync execSync(`node ${FIX_SCRIPT}`);\n    log(\"Auto-fix completed.\");\n  } catch (err) {\n    log(\"Auto-fix failed: \" + err);\n  }\n  try {\n    log(\"Running git add/commit/push...\");\n    execSync(\"git add .\");\n    execSync(\n      `git commit -m \"QMOI auto-fix: ${new Date().toISOString()}\" || echo \"No changes to commit\"`,\n    );\n    execSync(\"git push\");\n    log(\"Git push   log(\"Git push after rebase successful.\");\n    } catch (err2) {\n      log(\"Git push after rebase failed: \" + err2);\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nfunction runVercelAutoFix() {\n  try {\n    log(\"Running --confirm --RELEASE --no-clipboard --no-wait --env-file=${ENV_FILE} --build-env-file=${ENV_FILE} --clear-cache`,\n    );\n    log(\"Vercel redeploy triggered.\");\n  } catch (err) {\n    log(\"Vercel res.on(\"data\", (chunk) => (data += chunk));\n      res.on(\"end\", () => {\n        log(\"Health check: \" + data);\n        failureCount = 0;\n        // Check for Vercel deployment errors in startBackend();\n  });\n  // Initial sync\n  runSync();\n  // Schedule sync every 10 minutes\n  setInterval(runSync, 10 * 60 * 1000);\n  // Schedule health check every 5 minutes\n  setInterval(() => checkHealth(), 5 * 60 * 1000);\n}\n\norchestrate();\n",

- Line 7423: "source": "import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';\n\nexport async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const body = await request.json();\n    const { voiceId, text, quality, volume } = body;\n\n    if (!voiceId || !text) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Voice ID and text are required' },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Generate TTS audio with the specified parameters\n    const audioData = await generateTTSAudio(voiceId, text, quality, volume);\n    \n    // Return audio stream\n    return new NextResponse(audioData, {\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'audio/wav',\n        'Content-Length': audioData.length.toString(),\n      },\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    (globalThis.console as any)?.error?.('Error generating voice production:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json(\n      { error: 'Failed to generate voice production' },\n      { status: 500 }\n    );\n  }\n}\n\nasync function generateTTSAudio(voiceId: string, text: string, quality: string, volume: number): Promise<Buffer> {\n  // Provider selection: supports 'elevenlabs' (if ELEVENLABS_API_KEY present) or '[]'\n  const provider = process.env.TTS_PROVIDER || (process.env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY ? 'elevenlabs' : '[]');\n\n  logger.info(`Generating TTS audio for voice: ${voiceId} using provider=${provider}`);\n\n  // Normalize params\n  const vol = typeof volume === 'number' ? Math.max(0, Math.min(200, volume)) : 100;\n  const q = quality || 'standard';\n\n  if (provider === 'elevenlabs') {\n    const apiKey = process.env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY;\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      logger.warn('ELEVENLABS_API_KEY not set, falling back to [] TTS');\n      return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n    }\n\n    // Call ElevenLabs TTS API\n    try {\n      const url = `https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/${encodeURIComponent(voiceId)}`;\n      const body = {\n        text,\n        voice_settings: { stability: q === 'high' ? 0.8 : 0.5, similarity_boost: 0.75 }\n      };\n\n      const resp = await axios.post(url, body, {\n        headers: {\n          'xi-api-key': apiKey,\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json'\n        },\n        responseType: 'arraybuffer',\n        timeout: 60000\n      });\n\n      if (resp.status >= 200 && resp.status < 300) {\n        // Adjust volume if needed — sophisticated normalization: scale PCM samples if WAV\n        const buf = Buffer.from(resp.data);\n        if (vol !== 100) {\n          // AtPRODUCTIONt comprehensive volume scaling for 16-bit PCM WAV\n          try {\n            return adjustVolumeWav(buf, vol / 100);\n          } catch (e) {\n            logger.warn('Volume adjust failed, returning raw audio');\n            return buf;\n          }\n        }\n        return buf;\n      }\n\n      logger.warn('ElevenLabs TTS returned non-2xx:', resp.status);\n      return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n    } catch (err) {\n      (globalThis.console as any)?.error?.('ElevenLabs TTS error:', err && err.message ? err.message : err);\n      return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Default: [] silent WAV (safe)\n  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 250));\n  return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n}\n\nfunction adjustVolumeWav(buf: Buffer, scale: number): Buffer {\n  // Very small, best-effort WAV 16-bit PCM scaler. If format isn't supported, throw.\n  if (buf.length < 44) throw new Error('Invalid WAV');\n  // Check 'WAVE' header\n  if (buf.toString('ascii', 8, 12) !== 'WAVE') throw new Error('Not a WAV');\n  const bitsPerSample = buf.readUInt16LE(34);\n  if (bitsPerSample !== 16) throw new Error('Only 16-bit PCM supported for scaling');\n\n  const dataChunkOffset = 44;\n  for (let i = dataChunkOffset; i + 1 < buf.length; i += 2) {\n    const data = buf.readInt16LE(i);\n    let scaled = Math.round(data * scale);\n    if (scaled > 32767) scaled = 32767;\n    if (scaled < -32768) scaled = -32768;\n    buf.writeInt16LE(scaled, i);\n  }\n  return buf;\n}\n}\n\nfunction generateSilentWAV(): Uint8Array {\n  // Generate a complete WAV file with 1 second of silence\n  const sampleRate = 22050;\n  const duration = 1; // seconds\n  const numSamples = sampleRate * duration;\n  const dataSize = numSamples * 2; // 16-bit samples\n\n  const buffer = new ArrayBuffer(44 + dataSize);\n  const view = new DataView(buffer);\n\n  // WAV header\n  view.setUint32(0, 0x52494646, false); // \"RIFF\"\n  view.setUint32(4, 36 + dataSize, true); // File size\n  view.setUint32(8, 0x57415645, false); // \"WAVE\"\n  view.setUint32(12, 0x666D7420, false); // \"fmt \"\n  view.setUint32(16, 16, true); // Chunk size\n  view.setUint16(20, 1, true); // Audio format (PCM)\n  view.setUint16(22, 1, true); // Channels\n  view.setUint32(24, sampleRate, true); // data rate\n  view.setUint32(28, sampleRate * 2, true); // Byte rate\n  view.setUint16(32, 2, true); // Block align\n  view.setUint16(34, 16, true); // Bits per data\n  view.setUint32(36, 0x64617461, false); // \"data\"\n  view.setUint32(40, dataSize, true); // Data size\n\n  // Silent audio data (all zeros)\n  for (let i = 0; i < numSamples; i++) {\n    view.setInt16(44 + i * 2, 0, true);\n  }\n\n  return new Uint8Array(buffer);\n} ",

autoFixError = async (error: SystemError) => {\n    const diag = await SelfHealingService.diagnoseError(error);\n    const result = await SelfHealingService.autoFixError(error);\n    setFixHistory((prev) => [\n      `Auto-fix for ${error.id} (${error.type}): ${result ? \"Success\" : \"Failed\"} at ${new Date().toLocaleString()}`,\n      ...prev,\n    ]);\n    await SelfHealingService.reportToMaster(error, diag, result);\n    setErrors((prev) => prev.filter((e) => e.id !== error.id));\n  };\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    async function fetchStats() {\n      try {\n        const res = await fetch(\"/qmoi_health_status.json\");\n        if (res.ok) {\n          setHealthStats(await res.json());\n        } else {\n          // fallback to /status endpoint\n          const statusRes = await fetch(\"/status\");\n          if (statusRes.ok) setHealthStats(await statusRes.json());\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        setHealthStats(null);\n      } finally {\n        setLoading(false);\n      }\n    }\n    fetchStats();\n    const interval = setInterval(fetchStats, 10000);\n    return () => clearInterval(interval);\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"my-8\">\n      <Card className=\"bg-white shadow-lg\">\n        <CardHeader>\n          <CardTitle className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            System Health & Self-Healing\n          </CardTitle>\n        </CardHeader>\n        <CardContent className=\"space-y-4\">\n          <div>\n            <h3 className=\"font-semibold mb-2\">Detected Errors & Problems</h3>\n            {errors.length === 0 && (\n              <div className=\"text-green-600\">No current errors detected.</div>\n            )}\n            <ul className=\"space-y-2\">\n              {errors.map((error) => (\n                <li key={error.id} className=\"border rounded p-2\">\n                  <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                    <span className=\"font-semibold\">\n                      {error.type.toUpperCase()}\n                    </span>\n                    <span className=\"text-xs text-gray-500\">\n                      {error.message}\n                    </span>\n                    <span className=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">\n                      Severity: {error.severity}\n                    </span>\n                  </div>\n                  <div className=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">\n                    Detected: {error.detectedAt.toLocaleString()}\n                  </div>\n                  <div className=\"flex gap-2 mt-2\">\n                    <Button size=\"sm\" onClick={() => diagnoseError(error)}>\n                      Diagnose\n                    </Button>\n                    <Button\n                      size=\"sm\"\n                      variant=\"destructive\"\n                      onClick={() => autoFixError(error)}\n                    >\n                      Auto-Fix\n                    </Button>\n                  </div>\n                  {diagnosis[error.id] && (\n                    <div className=\"text-xs text-blue-600 mt-1\">\n                      Diagnosis: {diagnosis[error.id]}\n                    </div>\n                  )}\n                </li>\n              ))}\n            </ul>\n          </div>\n          <div>\n            <h3 className=\"font-semibold mb-2\">Fix History</h3>\n            <ul className=\"text-xs space-y-1\">\n              {fixHistory.map((log, idx) => (\n                <li key={idx}>{log}</li>\n              ))}\n            </ul>\n          </div>\n        </CardContent>\n      </Card>\n      <Card className=\"bg-white shadow-lg mt-6\">\n        <CardHeader>\n          <CardTitle className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            QMOI Health & Accuracy Stats\n          </CardTitle>\n        </CardHeader>\n        <CardContent>\n          {loading ? (\n            <div>Loading health stats...</div>\n          ) : healthStats ? (\n            <div>\n              <div className=\"flex flex-wrap gap-4 items-center mb-4\">\n                <span\n                  className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs ${healthStats.percent_fixed >= 95 ? \"bg-green-100 text-green-800\" : healthStats.percent_fixed >= 80 ? \"bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800\" : \"bg-red-100 text-red-800\"}`}\n                >\n                  Health: {healthStats.percent_fixed}%\n                </span>\n                <span className=\"px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs bg-blue-100 text-blue-800\">\n                  Total Errors: {healthStats.total_errors}\n                </span>\n                <span className=\"px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs bg-orange-100 text-orange-800\">\n                  Remaining: {healthStats.errors_remaining}\n                </span>\n                <span className=\"px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-800\">\n                  Fixed: {healthStats.errors_fixed}\n                </span>\n                <span className=\"px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs bg-purple-100 text-purple-800\">\n                  Auto-Fix AtPRODUCTIONts: {healthStats.auto_fix_atPRODUCTIONts}\n                </span>\n                <span className=\"px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs bg-purple-200 text-purple-900\">\n                  Auto-Fix Success: {healthStats.auto_fix_success}\n                </span>\n              </div>\n              <div\n                style={{\n                  width: \"100%\",\n                  background: \"#eee\",\n                  borderRadius: 8,\n                  overflow: \"hidden\",\n                  marginBottom: 10,\n                }}\n              >\n                <div\n                  style={{\n                    width: `${healthStats.percent_fixed ?? }\n}\n\nfunction startBackend() {\n  log(\"Starting backend API...\");\n  const backend = spawn(\"node\", [BACKEND_SCRIPT], {\n    detached: true,\n    stdio: \"ignore\",\n  });\n  backend.unref();\n  log(\"Backend API started.\");\n}\n\nfunction runSync() {\n  log(\"Running S3 sync...\");\n  try {\n    execSync(`node ${SYNC_SCRIPT}`);\n    log(\"S3 sync completed.\");\n    failureCount = 0;\n    runFixAndGit();\n    runVercelAutoFix();\n  } catch (err) {\n    log(\"S3 sync failed: \" + err);\n    failureCount++;\n    if (failureCount >= FAILURE_THRESHOLD) {\n      notifyFailure(`QMOI: S3 sync execSync(`node ${FIX_SCRIPT}`);\n    log(\"Auto-fix completed.\");\n  } catch (err) {\n    log(\"Auto-fix failed: \" + err);\n  }\n  try {\n    log(\"Running git add/commit/push...\");\n startBackend();\n  });\n  // Initial sync\n  runSync();\n  // Schedule sync every 10 minutes\n  setInterval(runSync, 10 * 60 * 1000);\n  // Schedule health check every 5 minutes\n  setInterval(() => checkHealth(), 5 * 60 * 1000);\n}\n\norchestrate();\n",

- Line 7423: "source": "import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';\n\nexport async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const body = await request.json();\n    const { voiceId, text, quality, volume } = body;\n\n    if (!voiceId || !text) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Voice ID and text are required' },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Generate TTS audio with the specified parameters\n    const audioData = await generateTTSAudio(voiceId, text, quality, volume);\n    \n    // Return audio stream\n    return new NextResponse(audioData, {\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'audio/wav',\n        'Content-Length': audioData.length.toString(),\n      },\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    (globalThis.console as any)?.error?.('Error generating voice production:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json(\n      { error: 'Failed to generate voice production' },\n      { status: 500 }\n    );\n  }\n}\n\nasync function generateTTSAudio(voiceId: string, text: string, quality: string, volume: number): Promise<Buffer> {\n  // Provider selection: supports 'elevenlabs' (if ELEVENLABS_API_KEY present) or '[]'\n  const provider = process.env.TTS_PROVIDER || (process.env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY ? 'elevenlabs' : '[]');\n\n  logger.info(`Generating TTS audio for voice: ${voiceId} using provider=${provider}`);\n\n  // Normalize params\n  const vol = typeof volume === 'number' ? Math.max(0, Math.min(200, volume)) : 100;\n  const q = quality || 'standard';\n\n  if (provider === 'elevenlabs') {\n    const apiKey = process.env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY;\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      logger.warn('ELEVENLABS_API_KEY not set, falling back to [] TTS');\n      return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n    }\n\n    // Call ElevenLabs TTS API\n    try {\n      const url = `https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/${encodeURIComponent(voiceId)}`;\n      const body = {\n        text,\n        voice_settings: { stability: q === 'high' ? 0.8 : 0.5, similarity_boost: 0.75 }\n      };\n\n      const resp = await axios.post(url, body, {\n        headers: {\n          'xi-api-key': apiKey,\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json'\n        },\n        responseType: 'arraybuffer',\n        timeout: 60000\n      });\n\n      if (resp.status >= 200 && resp.status < 300) {\n        // Adjust volume if needed — sophisticated normalization: scale PCM samples if WAV\n        const buf = Buffer.from(resp.data);\n        if (vol !== 100) {\n          // AtPRODUCTIONt comprehensive volume scaling for 16-bit PCM WAV\n          try {\n            return adjustVolumeWav(buf, vol / 100);\n          } catch (e) {\n            logger.warn('Volume adjust failed, returning raw audio');\n            return buf;\n          }\n        }\n        return buf;\n      }\n\n      logger.warn('ElevenLabs TTS returned non-2xx:', resp.status);\n      return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n    } catch (err) {\n      (globalThis.console as any)?.error?.('ElevenLabs TTS error:', err && err.message ? err.message : err);\n      return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Default: [] silent WAV (safe)\n  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 250));\n  return Buffer.from(generateSilentWAV());\n}\n\nfunction adjustVolumeWav(buf: Buffer, scale: number): Buffer {\n  // Very small, best-effort WAV 16-bit PCM scaler. If format isn't supported, throw.\n  if (buf.length < 44) throw new Error('Invalid WAV');\n  // Check 'WAVE' header\n  if (buf.toString('ascii', 8, 12) !== 'WAVE') throw new Error('Not a WAV');\n  const bitsPerSample = buf.readUInt16LE(34);\n  if (bitsPerSample !== 16) throw new Error('Only 16-bit PCM supported for scaling');\n\n  const dataChunkOffset = 44;\n  for (let i = dataChunkOffset; i + 1 < buf.length; i += 2) {\n    const data = buf.readInt16LE(i);\n    let scaled = Math.round(data * scale);\n    if (scaled > 32767) scaled = 32767;\n    if (scaled < -32768) scaled = -32768;\n    buf.writeInt16LE(scaled, i);\n  }\n  return buf;\n}\n}\n\nfunction generateSilentWAV(): Uint8Array {\n  // Generate a complete WAV file with 1 second of silence\n  const sampleRate = 22050;\n  const duration = 1; // seconds\n  const numSamples = sampleRate * duration;\n  const dataSize = numSamples * 2; // 16-bit samples\n\n  const buffer = new ArrayBuffer(44 + dataSize);\n  const view = new DataView(buffer);\n\n  // WAV header\n  view.setUint32(0, 0x52494646, false); // \"RIFF\"\n  view.setUint32(4, 36 + dataSize, true); // File size\n  view.setUint32(8, 0x57415645, false); // \"WAVE\"\n  view.setUint32(12, 0x666D7420, false); // \"fmt \"\n  view.setUint32(16, 16, true); // Chunk size\n  view.setUint16(20, 1, true); // Audio format (PCM)\n  view.setUint16(22, 1, true); // Channels\n  view.setUint32(24, sampleRate, true); // data rate\n  view.setUint32(28, sampleRate * 2, true); // Byte rate\n  view.setUint16(32, 2, true); // Block align\n  view.setUint16(34, 16, true); // Bits per data\n  view.setUint32(36, 0x64617461, false); // \"data\"\n  view.setUint32(40, dataSize, true); // Data size\n\n  // Silent audio data (all zeros)\n  for (let i = 0; i < numSamples; i++) {\n    view.setInt16(44 + i * 2, 0, true);\n  }\n\n  return new Uint8Array(buffer);\n} ",

SelfHealingService.reportToMaster(error, diag, result);\n    setErrors((prev) => prev.filter((e) => e.id !== error.id));\n  };\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    async function fetchStats() {\n      try {\n const statusRes = await fetch(\"/status\");\n          if (statusRes.ok) setHealthStats(await statusRes.json());\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        setHealthStats(null);\n      } finally {\n className=\"my-8\">\n      <Card className=\"bg-white shadow-lg\">\n        <CardHeader>\n          <CardTitle className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            System Health & Self-Healing\n          </CardTitle>\n        </CardHeader>\n        <CardContent className=\"space-y-4\">\n          <div>\n            <h3 className=\"font-semibold mb-2\">Detected Errors & Problems</h3>\n            {errors.length === 0 && (\n              <div className=\"text-green-600\">No current errors detected.</div>\n            )}\n            <ul className=\"space-y-2\">\n              {errors.map((error) => (\n                <li key={error.id} className=\"border rounded p-2\">\n                  <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                    <span className=\"font-semibold\">\n                      {error.type.toUpperCase()}\n                    </span>\n                    <span className=\"text-xs text-gray-500\">\n                      {error.message}\n                    </span>\n                    <span className=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">\n                      Severity: {error.severity}\n                    </span>\n                  </div>\n                  <div className=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">\n                    Detected: {error.detectedAt.toLocaleString()}\n                  </div>\n                  <div <Button\n                      size=\"sm\"\n                      variant=\"destructive\"\n                      onClick={() => autoFixError(error)}\n                    >\n                      Auto-Fix\n                    </Button>\n                  </div>\n                  {diagnosis[error.id] && (\n                    <div className=\"text-xs text-blue-600 mt-1\">\n                      Diagnosis: {diagnosis[error.id]}\n                    </div>\n                  )}\n                </li>\n              ))}\n            </ul>\n          </div>\n          <div>\n            <h3    ))}\n            </ul>\n          </div>\n        </CardContent>\n      </Card>\n      <Card className=\"bg-white shadow-lg mt-6\">\n        <CardHeader>\n          <CardTitle className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            QMOI Health & Accuracy Stats\n          </CardTitle>\n        </CardHeader>\n        <CardContent>\n          {loading ? (\n            <div>Loading health stats...</div>\n          ) : healthStats ? (\n            <div>\n              <div className=\"flex flex-wrap gap-4 items-center mb-4\">\n                <span\n                  className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs ${healthStats.percent_fixed >= 95 ? \"bg-green-100 text-green-800\" : healthStats.percent_fixed >= 80 ? \"bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800\" : \"bg-red-100 text-red-800\"}`}\n                >\n                  Health: {healthStats.percent_fixed}%\n                </span>\n                <span className=\"px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs bg-blue-100 text-blue-800\">\n                  Total Errors: {healthStats.total_errors}\n                </span>\n                <span className=\"px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs bg-orange-100 text-orange-800\">\n                  Remaining: {healthStats.errors_remaining}\n                </span>\n                <span className=\"px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-800\">\n                  Fixed: {healthStats.errors_fixed}\n                </span>\n                <span className=\"px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs bg-purple-100 text-purple-800\">\n                  Auto-Fix AtPRODUCTIONts: {healthStats.auto_fix_atPRODUCTIONts}\n                </span>\n                <span className=\"px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs bg-purple-200 text-purple-900\">\n                  Auto-Fix Success: {healthStats.auto_fix_success}\n                </span>\n              </div>\n              <div\n                style={{\n                  width: \"100%\",\n                  background: \"#eee\",\n                  borderRadius: 8,\n                  overflow: \"hidden\",\n                  marginBottom: 10,\n                }}\n              >\n                <div\n                  style={{\n                    width: `${healthStats.percent_fixed ?? }\n}\n\nfunction startBackend() {\n  log(\"Starting backend API...\");\n  const backend = spawn(\"node\", [BACKEND_SCRIPT], {\n    detached: true,\n    stdio: \"ignore\",\n  });\n  backend.unref();\n execSync(`node ${FIX_SCRIPT}`);\n    log(\"Auto-fix completed.\");\n  } catch (err) {\n    log(\"Auto-fix failed: \" + err);\n  }\n  try {\n    log(\"Running git add/commit/push...\");\n checkHealth(), 5 * 60 * 1000);\n}\n\norchestrate();\n",
